system.description:
Use this skill at the same time you use a [Toxin]. 

(Hate 1): The [Toxin] can be used with [Range: 4 Sq.].
(Hate 2): The [Toxin] can be used with [Target: Area (P)].
(Fate 1): The [Toxin] can be used with [Target: Area (P)].

Vaporize magic potion, apply it to something and throw it, etc., and have an effect on a distant target or multiple opponents.
